property_summary: The transfer function always returns true when it does not revert.
The transfer function returns true when it completes without revert.
The transfer function returns true when it completes without revert.
The transfer function should not allow transfers that would result in no tokens actually being moved (i.e., v > 0).
The transfer function must use the ERC20 transferFrom selector, not the transfer selector.
After calling transfer, the transaction does not revert when the inner call fails.
After a call to transfer, the return value is always true when the inner call fails.
After a call to transfer with at least one to address, the transaction either reverts or the inner call always succeeds (i.e., the require inside the loop never fails).
After a call to transfer with multiple recipients, if any inner call reverts, the entire transaction reverts.
After a call to transfer with a valid to address that causes a revert in the inner call, the reference contract always reverts the entire transaction, while the buggy contract does not.
The transfer function reverts when called with a non-empty array of recipients.
The transfer function succeeds (returns true) when called with a non-empty _tos array.
The transfer function does not revert when called with an empty _tos array.
The transfer function fails (reverts or returns false) when called with a non-empty _tos array, while the reference version succeeds.
The transfer function should not revert when called with a non-empty array of recipients.
The transfer function must actually make the external calls for all provided recipient addresses; the loop must execute at least once for a non-empty array.
The balance of each recipient address must increase by at least v after transfer, because the loop must execute for all tos.
The transfer function must revert when the recipient array is non-empty and the loop does not execute.
The transfer function must make exactly _tos.length external calls (one per recipient) for any non-empty _tos array.
For a non-empty _tos array, the return value of transfer must be true, because the loop always runs at least once.
